quote: Justice isn't asked for; it's done.
bio: Héctor believes in a better world and is ready to fight for it. His faith is his shield and his sword, and his allies are his family.

abilities.name: Divine Smite
abilities.effect: Adds radiant damage to a blow that has already landed. Declare it after the hit.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.effect: Restores 5 hit points by touch, which can be split up. It can also cure a poison or a disease.

abilities.name: Aura of Courage
abilities.effect: Allies at his side have advantage against fear.

abilities.name: Sense Corruption
abilities.effect: Senses unnatural presences nearby, without pinpointing where they are.

goal: Protect those who can't protect themselves.
